security_spec.violation_condition: XiangShan RTL implements HWCFG2_en (bit 1) or HWCFG3_en (bit 2) in the HWCFG0 CSR as W1SS (write-1-set-sticky) instead of R (read-only, implementation-defined), allowing software to write 1 to these bits and cause the hardware to report HWCFG2/HWCFG3 as available when the extension hardware is not actually implemented — software then configures non-priority entries or HWCFG3-dependent features that the IOPMP checker cannot enforce
security_spec.summary: HWCFG0 HWCFG2_en/HWCFG3_en reclassified from W1SS to R — stale W1SS hardware allows software to forge feature-enable capability flags, tricking firmware into relying on absent IOPMP hardware enforcement features
